name: Abraham
sub: Ur to Canaan, Egypt and back
blurb: Terah sets out from Ur with Abram, settles in Haran, and Abram goes on to Canaan at God's call. The places are named in Genesis; the roads between them are a sketch.

stops.t: Terah settles in Haran; Abram is called to go on
Abram builds an altar between Bethel and Ai

stops.note: Famine drives Abram south; the exact place in Egypt is not named.

stops.t: Abram moves his tent to the oaks of Mamre

stops.note: Abram chases the kings north to rescue Lot.

stops.t: Isaac is born; Hagar in the wilderness of Beersheba

stops.note: 2 Chronicles 3:1 places Mount Moriah where Solomon built the Temple.

name: Jacob
sub: Beersheba to Haran, back to Canaan, down to Egypt
blurb: Jacob runs from Esau to his uncle Laban in Haran, returns twenty years later with a large family, is renamed Israel at the Jabbok, and in old age goes down to Egypt to see Joseph.

stops.t: Jacob flees; the covenant at Mizpah
Esau embraces Jacob; Succoth and Shechem
Dinah and the men of Shechem
Rachel dies; Benjamin born; Isaac dies
Jacob comes home to his father Isaac, who dies at 180
God speaks to Jacob at Beersheba
Jacob meets Joseph; Pharaoh welcomes the family

name: Joseph
sub: From the pit to the palace
blurb: Sent by his father to find his brothers, Joseph is sold at Dothan and taken to Egypt, where he rises from slave and prisoner to ruler. He goes up to Canaan once more to bury Jacob, and his bones are carried back at the exodus.

stops.t: Jacob sends Joseph to see how his brothers are
Joseph wanders in the fields looking for his brothers

stops.note: Potiphar’s house, the prison and Pharaoh’s court: Genesis does not name the city.

stops.t: Joseph rides out in his chariot to meet his father
Joseph leads a great procession to bury Jacob
Joseph dies at 110 and asks that his bones be carried up from Egypt
Joseph’s bones are buried in the plot Jacob bought

name: The Exodus
blurb: Israel leaves Egypt, crosses the sea, meets God at Sinai, wanders 40 years and reaches the Jordan. Most wilderness sites are debated; this follows the traditional southern route to Jebel Musa.

stops.t: Israel sets out from Rameses (Pi-Ramesses, at Qantir)
The waters part. Proposals range from the Bitter Lakes to the Gulf of Suez and beyond.
The Ten Commandments and the covenant. Jebel Musa is the traditional site; others are proposed.
The spies report; Israel refuses to enter and wanders 40 years (Ein el-Qudeirat)
Moses sees the land and dies
The river stops and Israel crosses near Jericho

name: The birth of Jesus
blurb: Mary and Joseph travel to Bethlehem for the census, present Jesus at the Temple, flee to Egypt from Herod and come home to Nazareth.

stops.t: The angel Gabriel appears to Mary

stops.note: Matthew does not say where in Egypt.

name: Paul's first journey
blurb: Barnabas and Saul are sent from Antioch to Cyprus and the cities of south Galatia, then retrace their steps to strengthen the new churches.

stops.t: Lystra: the crowd calls them gods

stops.note: They go back through Lystra, Iconium and Pisidian Antioch, then sail from Attalia.

name: Paul's second journey
blurb: Paul and Silas revisit Galatia, pick up Timothy, cross to Macedonia after a vision and plant churches in Philippi, Thessalonica, Berea and Corinth.

stops.t: The vision of the man of Macedonia
Paul at the Areopagus in Athens
A vow at Cenchreae; a short stop at Ephesus
stops.note: A short stop on the way home.

stops.t: He lands at Caesarea and goes up to greet the church

name: Paul's third journey
blurb: Paul spends about three years in Ephesus, travels through Macedonia to Greece, then heads for Jerusalem with the collection for the poor.

stops.t: Paul in Ephesus: the Spirit, Tyrannus, the burning scrolls

stops.note: Three months in Greece; Romans was likely written here.

name: The voyage to Rome
blurb: A prisoner who has appealed to Caesar, Paul sails west, survives a storm and a shipwreck on Malta, and reaches Rome.

stops.t: Julius lets Paul visit his friends
